generator.note: Draft derived from primary JSONL evidence; checked by agent/scripts/inventory_work_sessions.py

scope.description: Pi agent sessions of the native Pi /tree back-in-history work (pi-smart-compact, 2026-11-02) discoverable in the sessions directory.
scope.exclusions: Other dates in the same directory are out of scope. Sessions in other directories or workspaces, RPC-only runs and manually opened panes without ownership records are not scanned or not visible.

discovery.method: Header line of every in-scope JSONL; pi-subagent-herdr-ownership-v1 custom entries (owner sessionId + pane records); first user message of each session (sha256); codemode launch calls located by subagent_start name.
discovery.snapshot_note: Lead and steward sessions were still being appended during the scan; recorded entry IDs are stable, later entries are not covered.

identity_rules: session_id = header id of the JSONL. launched_by is set only when an ownership custom entry lists the pane. Roles come from first user message text and matching launch task names. Filenames and timestamps alone are not used as evidence of delegation. Pane-to-session links are never verified: ownership records name the owner and pane; no child header or entry records the child session id for a pane, so verification.pane_to_session_link is inferred whenever launched_by is set. first_user_message must be the first user message in file order, not merely any user message.

limitations: Headers carry no parent field; delegation is established only via pi-subagent-herdr-ownership-v1 records plus prompt and launch-task text.
Identical-role pairs (memory scouts, reviewers) are mapped by prompt scope text only: memory-main vs memory-peer scope; 'Critically review plan' vs 'Independently rethink'.
retire-live pane w1:p8 has no matching session file in this directory.
09-11-11, 09-11-33 and 09-58-03 are unlisted candidates; their relationship is unresolved.

Lead and steward sessions were still active during the scan; compaction entries may summarize earlier turns.

Snapshot validity: JSONL files are live. The validator treats malformed nonblank lines as errors; a file without a trailing newline may be a partial live write (transient-read caveat), so re-run after the writer flushes.
